newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PSN awards Loral unit contract.
newsitem.headline: PSN awards Loral unit contract.

text.p: Indonesian satellite company PT Pasifik Satelit Nusantara (PSN) said on Wednesday it signed a $350 million contract with Space Systems/Loral, a unit of Loral Space and Communications Ltd, for the procurement of its Multi Media Asia (M2A) Satellite System.

Pasifik Satelit chief executive officer Adi R. Adiwoso said that M2A is the first satellite-based system to provide consumer telecom services as an adjunct to the public-switched telephone network on a major scale.

"Our business plan assumes a low per minute rate, though ultimately we would like to have a flat rate charge for unlimited usage. Our goal is to offer an affordable terminal, marketing it as a primary phone in remote areas of Indonesia and a secondary one in penetrated urban areas," Adiwoso said in the statement.
It said the launch of the M2A was scheduled in the first quarter of 1999, with services operational by midyear with a coverage area of the Asia-Pacific region.
"We have received a lot of outside interest in this project, and eventually we may select strategic partners to join in the M2A programme, but PSN would always retain a majority stake," Adiwoso said.
